title: Convert FamilyConnect to Progressive Web App

requirements.summary: Enhance PWA manifest with complete metadata and comprehensive icon set for full app installation experience
acceptanceCriteria: PWA manifest includes all required fields for app installation
App can be installed on mobile devices and desktop browsers
App displays in standalone mode without browser UI when launched
App icons appear correctly on home screen and app drawer

file_operations.description: Enhance manifest with complete metadata including short_name, description, start_url, display: 'standalone', orientation preferences, background_color, theme_color, categories, and comprehensive icon set referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon-192.dim_192x192.png, app-icon-512.dim_512x512.png, and app-icon-maskable.dim_512x512.png with appropriate purpose attributes
Add manifest link if missing and ensure theme-color meta tag matches manifest theme_color for consistent branding across platforms

requirements.summary: Upgrade service worker with advanced caching strategies, background sync, and cache versioning for full offline functionality
acceptanceCriteria: App loads and displays cached content when offline
User actions made offline are queued and sync when connection restored
Service worker updates cleanly without leaving stale caches
Users see appropriate offline status indicators

file_operations.description: Upgrade service worker to implement versioned caching with CACHE_NAME constant, precache critical assets during install event, implement cache-first strategy for static assets with fallback, network-first for API calls, and add background sync registration for POST requests when offline with proper sync event handling and cache cleanup on activation
Add service worker registration logic with update detection, prompt user for reload when new version available, and implement proper error handling for registration failures
Create custom React hook that monitors navigator.onLine and online/offline events to provide real-time online status, returning isOnline boolean and triggering re-renders on connectivity changes
Create component that uses useOnlineStatus hook to display a dismissible banner or toast when offline, informing users that changes will sync when connection is restored
Import and render OfflineIndicator component in the layout to display offline status across all pages

requirements.summary: Add iOS-specific meta tags and configurations for optimal installation experience on iOS devices
acceptanceCriteria: App can be added to iOS home screen with proper icon
App launches in fullscreen mode on iOS without Safari UI
Status bar styling matches app theme on iOS
Splash screen displays during app launch on iOS

file_operations.description: Add iOS-specific meta tags including apple-mobile-web-app-capable set to 'yes', apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style set to 'black-translucent' or theme-appropriate value, apple-mobile-web-app-title, apple-touch-icon links for various sizes (180x180 minimum), and apple-touch-startup-image links referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/splash-iphone.dim_750x1334.png and splash-ipad.dim_1536x2048.png with appropriate media queries for device targeting

requirements.summary: Implement app-like navigation patterns with native-feeling transitions and gesture support
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation feels smooth with app-like transitions
Swipe gestures work for appropriate navigation actions
Android hardware back button functions correctly
Navigation history is preserved across app restarts

file_operations.description: Add page transition animations using CSS transitions or Framer Motion, ensure router properly manages history stack, and implement popstate event listener for Android hardware back button support with proper cleanup

Create custom hook that uses touch events to detect swipe gestures (touchstart, touchmove, touchend) and trigger navigation actions when swipe threshold is met, supporting left/right swipes for back/forward navigation with proper coordinate tracking
Integrate useSwipeNavigation hook to enable gesture-based navigation across the app, applying swipe handlers to appropriate container elements with proper touch-action CSS
Add CSS transition classes for page navigation animations including slide-in, slide-out, and fade effects with appropriate timing functions and durations for smooth app-like feel

requirements.summary: Add install prompt functionality with custom in-app installation banner
acceptanceCriteria: Install banner appears when app meets PWA criteria
Users can dismiss or trigger installation from banner
Banner respects user preferences and doesn't reappear if dismissed
Installation success is tracked and banner hidden after install

file_operations.description: Create custom hook that captures beforeinstallprompt event, stores the deferred prompt, provides showPrompt function to trigger installation, tracks installation state via appinstalled event, and manages localStorage for dismissed state with timestamp

Create banner component that uses useInstallPrompt hook to display installation invitation with clear call-to-action button, dismiss functionality that persists to localStorage, and automatic hiding after installation or dismissal
Import and conditionally render InstallPromptBanner component in layout, positioned prominently at top or bottom of viewport when installable and not dismissed

requirements.summary: Optimize app performance for mobile devices with lazy loading, image optimization, and reduced bundle size
acceptanceCriteria: Initial load time is under 3 seconds on 3G connection
Routes load on-demand rather than upfront
Images are properly compressed and use responsive formats
Loading indicators appear for operations taking >300ms

file_operations.description: Implement lazy loading for all route components using React.lazy and Suspense, wrapping each page import in lazy() with fallback loading component to reduce initial bundle size and enable code splitting
Create reusable loading spinner component with consistent styling and animations for use in Suspense fallbacks and loading states across the application

Implement lazy loading for images using Intersection Observer or lazy loading attributes, add loading states during image fetch with LoadingSpinner, and ensure ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() usage for streaming and caching optimization
Add loading states using LoadingSpinner for data-heavy widgets that take >300ms to load, ensuring smooth user experience during data fetching with proper skeleton screens or spinners

Review and optimize query configurations to add appropriate staleTime and cacheTime values, implement proper loading states, and ensure queries handle slow connections gracefully with timeout configurations

requirements.summary: Implement responsive design improvements with touch-optimized tap targets and appropriate spacing
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements meet minimum touch target size
Layout adapts smoothly across device sizes
No horizontal scrolling on any device
Text remains readable without zooming on all devices

file_operations.description: Add global CSS rules ensuring minimum touch target sizes of 44x44px for all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs), add touch-action properties for better gesture handling, and ensure proper spacing with mobile-first padding/margins

Add custom utility classes for touch targets, ensure responsive breakpoints cover all device sizes, add mobile-first spacing scale, and configure typography scale for optimal readability on small screens without zooming

Review and enhance responsive layout with proper viewport handling, ensure navigation bar is touch-friendly with adequate tap target spacing, and implement mobile-first responsive grid for content areas
Ensure chat widget buttons and input areas meet minimum touch target requirements, improve mobile layout with proper spacing, and optimize draggable behavior for touch interactions

Enhance dashboard grid layout responsiveness across device sizes, ensure widgets stack properly on mobile with adequate spacing, and verify all interactive elements meet touch target size requirements
